items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: We all lived there together... we had all that work out there... Buddy made this banjo there... he was a good banjo player.

ctx.x: over there we stayed there. You stayed over there then? Yeah. We all lived there together. We stayed there for about four years, four or five years we stayed over there. Over there in Covington or Mansfield? Yeah in Covington. You see because Covington was our headquarters. See because we leave out Covington, we go play in Burgalusa, Picayune, Lumberton. Well we had all that work out there, Harrisburg, and different places you know. Well all that work come from there you see. And that's why we had to stay over…
I guess we've heard of it anyway. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Any more about Buddy Manda today? Can you tell us? He played banjo. Did he play guitar too? Well I don't know. I never

seen him play no guitar but he was a good banjo player. Buddy made this banjo there. That's the banjo he made himself. You know what I mean? Yeah it's got an unusual head on it. Yeah, head on it. That's right. It's like a guitar head. And that was a good one too. He made it and he was waiting. Every time he'd catch him he was doing something on that banjo. But he was really good at it.
